In detail

North of the centre, with Kuchajda lake and the Slimák area, which the city names among its monitored spots. Otherwise residential and commercial, and the part of Bratislava most visitors only pass through.

This specific area was reviewed against credible local sources — local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist — and the signals were consolidated across sources rather than taken from any single report, with the reasoning and the sources shown above. Frequently asked questions

Is Nové Mesto safe?

Wandroz currently rates Nové Mesto in Bratislava as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Bratislava during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Bratislava at night. This comes from a structured local-source assessment: an area-level review of credible local sources — local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist — consolidated across sources rather than taken from a single report. Bratislava publishes no comparable neighbourhood-level crime dataset; where a city does, Wandroz uses it instead.

Is Nové Mesto safe at night?

At night, Nové Mesto is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Bratislava. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Nové Mesto a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Nové Mesto's day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Bratislava) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late. You can search accommodation already filtered to this specific area using the Booking.com link on this page.

Is there official crime data for Nové Mesto?

Not an official government crime feed — Nové Mesto's rating comes from Wandroz's own current local/national press and survey research for this specific area instead (see the note on this page for what was checked and the sources used).
